class.name: OcgGeom2dAxisplacement
class.brief_description: Describes an axis in 2D space. An axis is defined by: - its origin, also termed the "Location point" of the axis, - its unit vector, termed the "Direction" of the axis. Note: Geom2d_AxisPlacement axes provide the same kind of "geometric" services as gp_Ax2d axes but have more complex data structures. The geometric objects provided by the Geom2d package use gp_Ax2d objects to include axes in their data structures, or to define an axis of symmetry or axis of rotation. Geom2d_AxisPlacement axes are used in a context where they can be shared by several objects contained inside a common data structure.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs an axis by conversion of the gp_Ax2d axis A.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an axis from a given origin P and unit vector V.

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the unit vector of this axis. Note: - Reverse assigns the result to this axis, while - Reversed creates a new one.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Changes the complete definition of the axis placement.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Changes the "Direction" of the axis placement.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the "Location" point (origin) of the axis placement.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angle between the "Direction" of two axis placement in radians. The result is comprised between -Pi and Pi.

method.name: Ax2d
method.description: Converts this axis into a gp_Ax2d axis.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the "Location" point (origin) of the axis placement. -C++: return const&

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this axis.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this axis.
